import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x):
    return float(np.round(float(x), 2))


def pct(x):
    return float(np.round(float(x), 1))


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({"entity": str(entity), "metric": metric, "period": period,
                      "value": float(value), "formula": formula})

    for c in ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
              "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)

    # --- Totals ---
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(ly), "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", pct((tw - lw) / lw * 100),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", pct((tw - ly) / ly * 100),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")

    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(u_tw), "sum(Units_TW)")
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", pct((u_tw - u_lw) / u_lw * 100),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(o_tw), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", pct((o_tw - o_lw) / o_lw * 100),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # --- Largest entities this week ---
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for this product")
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        sh = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r["Share_Pct"]) else (
            r["Revenue_TW"] / tw * 100 if tw else np.nan)
        if pd.notna(sh):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", pct(sh), "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    if len(top):
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", pct(top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tw * 100) if tw else None,
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", num(top.iloc[0]["Rank"]),
            "Rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    # --- Biggest absolute WoW movers ---
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    if len(d):
        for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["abs_wow"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
        for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow").head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["abs_wow"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # --- Biggest percent WoW movers (material base only) ---
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct", "Revenue_LW"])
    p = p[p["Revenue_LW"] >= max(100.0, p["Revenue_LW"].median())]
    if len(p):
        for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", pct(r["WoW_Pct"]),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
        for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", pct(r["WoW_Pct"]),
                "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # --- Biggest absolute YoY movers ---
    y = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    y = y[y["Revenue_LY"] > 0]
    y["abs_yoy"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
    if len(y):
        for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["abs_yoy"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
        for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy").head(2).iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["abs_yoy"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")

    yp = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct", "Revenue_LY"])
    yp = yp[yp["Revenue_LY"] >= max(100.0, yp["Revenue_LY"].median())]
    if len(yp):
        r = yp.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", pct(r["YoY_Pct"]),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
        r = yp.sort_values("YoY_Pct").iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", pct(r["YoY_Pct"]),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # --- Top units entity ---
    uu = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if len(uu):
        r = uu.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(r["Units_TW"]), "max(Units_TW) across products")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
